# SCI-MAP v0.1 r0.7 Rationale/Formal/ECS Parity

The rationale, formal contract, and Engineering Conformance Specification
each import exactly one byte-identical
`SCI-MAP-v0.1_SHARED_AUTHORITY_r0.7.tex` wrapper and the same six common
modules in fixed order:
`notation`, `definitions`, `equations`, `assumptions`, `requirements`, and
`edge_cases`. The rationale provides a concise grouped route to the canonical
requirements/predictions rather than rendering the full inventories; it does
not weaken or strengthen a formal gate.

Automated checks require 52 unique contiguous requirement IDs and 25 unique
contiguous prediction IDs in both formal and ECS rendered text, nine stable
owner-decision IDs with eight open, exact profile/boundary identities, and
absence of the repaired stale terms. The source manifest records the
byte-ordered shared-authority digest. The formal and ECS render the same
generated owner register; the rationale's compact register is checked against
the same ledger semantics. No audience view may redefine a common
equation, gate, exposure population, response role, or coadd policy.
